findings: learner.overview.text: Replace the grains-first explanation with a brief account of the disputed construction: the received analysis treats 小 as meaning “small” and 丿 as a sound element, while early 少 and 小 overlap and another analysis proposes a grain picture. Keep the grain referent uncertain. The current overview foregrounds an unresolved pictorial proposal without explaining the competing received analysis that the learner component cards then introduce. Cite E3, X-3e7c7db97d01891137c7, X-519d63d819029d5b5600, X-8487cd1cb9ca11b26969.

learner.components[1].text: Replace “its place in the original graph is uncertain” with wording that says early graphic evidence does not establish whether 丿 had the sound role assigned by the received analysis. The current phrasing leaves unclear whether only the stroke’s location or its proposed role is uncertain. Cite E3, X-8487cd1cb9ca11b26969.
